clue.text: Vacant single bed inside for writer

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other, as the bed goes inside
a vacant word has had its contents emptied out, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: a crib is a baby's bed

explanation.surface: Someone single is looking for a writer to share an empty bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vacant' empties 'single' to its outer letters S and E; 'inside' puts CRIB between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A scribe is a copyist or, more loosely, any author or journalist.

clue.text: Have sex with more than three on the French carpet

parts.note: shag is British slang meaning to have sex
pi is about 3.14, a little more than three
le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: A suggestive invitation to get frisky on the floor with several partners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'More than three' is not a threesome hint but the number pi, 3.14159... SHAG PILE is a carpet with a long, thick pile.
explanation.definitionFit: A shag pile is a type of rug or floor covering with long loose fibres.

clue.text: Franco urged to suppress resentment

indicators.note: the words hold down and conceal the letters inside them

explanation.surface: General Franco is being told to put down a rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is bitter, long-lasting ill feeling, a synonym of resentment.

clue.text: Reading lines penned by Crosby

indicators.note: penned means enclosed, so the lines sit inside the singer's name

parts.note: Bing Crosby was the American crooner
rows are lines

explanation.surface: Reading some lyrics written by Bing Crosby.
explanation.definitionFit: Browsing is reading casually, dipping into a book or skimming pages.

clue.text: Olympic event, for one, a master's city

indicators.note: one thing is put in place of another, here a master taking the place of one

parts.note: the discus is an Olympic throwing event
I is the Roman numeral one
MA is a Master of Arts degree; the 's reads as 'is'

explanation.surface: A master's home city hosting an Olympic event.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'a master's for one' as 'A MA is for I': the I in DISCUS is replaced by A MA.
explanation.definitionFit: Damascus is the capital of Syria, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities.

clue.text: Islands wind up being held by corrupt rich OAP

indicators.note: one piece is gripped inside the other
corrupt means spoilt or altered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: OAP is a British abbreviation for old age pensioner

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: a gale is a strong wind

explanation.surface: A wealthy but crooked pensioner is getting wound up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wind' looks like a verb to go with 'up', but it is the noun, a strong blow, read upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: An archipelago is a group or chain of islands.

clue.text: It's not like this clue to be a hybrid

definitions.note: this clue runs downward, so its opposite runs the other way in the grid

parts.note: a cross is a hybrid of two breeds or varieties

explanation.surface: A self-referential remark about the clue itself being a mongrel.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the grid: this is a down clue, so the thing it is not is the other direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A down clue is the opposite of one running horizontally, which is what the definition points to.

clue.text: Greek character opposed to what might be ordered in 13 down

definitions.text: what might be ordered in 13 down

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
anti means against

explanation.surface: A Greek man turns up his nose at the menu in an Italian restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 down is TRATTORIA, an Italian restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a Tuscan red wine, the classic bottle ordered with a meal in an Italian eatery.

clue.text: From then till now, bank with honesty

parts.note: since means from a past time up to the present
to bank on something is to rely on it

explanation.surface: A banking slogan about honest dealing over the years.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something sincerely means doing it genuinely and truthfully, an adverbial synonym.

clue.text: Baby wrap an omnishambles

indicators.note: a shambles is a chaotic mess, so the letters before it are jumbled

parts.note: the first four letters of the clue's last word

explanation.surface: Swaddling a baby has turned into a complete fiasco.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal hides inside a single word: 'omnishambles' splits into its first four letters and 'shambles', which jumbles them with 'an'.
explanation.definitionFit: The amnion is the membrane enclosing a foetus in the womb, a sac wrapped round the unborn child.

clue.text: Picaroon's puzzle's not a stinger

indicators.note: puzzle signals jumbling the letters, and 'not' says the a must come out of the mix

explanation.surface: A judgement that a rival Guardian setter's crossword lacks bite.
explanation.walkthrough: Picaroon is another Guardian setter. Take the letters of PICAROONS, remove A, and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorpion is an arachnid with a venomous sting in its tail.

clue.text: Complaint of junior doctor pocketing floppy disk has been uncovered

indicators.note: pocketing means taking in, so the junior doctor holds the other piece

parts.note: a houseman is a junior hospital doctor in Britain

indicators.note: floppy means loose and limp, signalling the letters are rearranged
with its cover stripped, a word loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A junior doctor has been caught with a computer floppy disk.
explanation.walkthrough: A houseman is the British term for a hospital doctor in their first year; 'has' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Housemaid's knee is inflammation of the kneecap bursa, an ailment from prolonged kneeling.

clue.text: Radio and TV broadcast must include Home Is Where The Heart Is

parts.note: radio and television are the broadcast media

indicators.note: include means one piece takes in another
broadcast means scattered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A broadcaster must air the sitcom 'Home Is Where The Heart Is'.
explanation.walkthrough: The proverb is split: 'Home' gives IN and 'Is' is a link, leaving 'Where The Heart Is' as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The mediastinum is the central compartment of the chest cavity, housing the heart.

clue.text: Laments acknowledgement I put into trilogies

indicators.note: these pieces are placed inside the other word

parts.note: trilogies are sets of three, or threes
a nod is a sign of acknowledgement

explanation.surface: A writer of trilogies inserts a note of thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: Threnodies are songs of mourning or dirges, a synonym of laments.

clue.text: Display excessive skill over restaurant

indicators.note: over means turned the other way, so the pieces read upward

parts.note: to air is to display
OTT is short for over the top
art is skill

explanation.surface: A chef shows off with too much flair in the dining room.
explanation.definitionFit: A trattoria is a simple Italian eatery.

clue.text: See 1 down
Fall of everybody climbing trees outside

indicators.note: one piece goes around the other

parts.note: a copse is a small group of trees

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the word reads upwards

parts.note: all means everybody

explanation.surface: Everyone climbing trees risks a tumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Collapse means a sudden fall or breakdown, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Top copy (Times)

parts.note: to ape is to copy or imitate
X is the multiplication sign, read as 'times'

explanation.surface: A page-one copy of The Times newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: An apex is the peak or summit, the topmost point.

clue.text: See to car and jet crash — with this?

definitions.text: See to car and jet crash — with this?

indicators.note: a crash smashes things up, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Arranging an escape device for car and jet crashes.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue doubles as a description: a pilot sees to a jet crash by escaping with this device.
explanation.definitionFit: An ejector seat catapults a pilot clear of an aircraft about to crash.

clue.text: Opening to examine innards of engine, a mate having reversed battery terminal

indicators.note: the earlier pieces are turned round to read backwards

parts.note: a motor is an engine
a pal is a mate or friend

indicators.note: a terminal letter is the last one of the word

explanation.surface: A mechanic opening an engine finds a partner has wired the battery terminal backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having reversed' turns MOTOR A PAL into LAPAROTOM. 'Innards' belongs to the definition, not a selection signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A laparotomy is a surgical incision into the abdomen, often exploratory.

clue.text: Misdeed of criminal

parts.note: a fence is a criminal who receives stolen goods

explanation.surface: A wrongdoing by a lawbreaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Criminal' wants to be an anagram signal for 'of'; it is a noun, the receiver of stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: An offence is a crime or wrongful act.

clue.text: Bird flu affects little children, only not at first

indicators.note: the opening letter of each preceding word is taken

explanation.surface: A health report says bird flu hits young children, though not initially.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Only not at first' looks like an exclusion, but 'at first' takes the initials of all six words.
explanation.definitionFit: A falcon is a bird of prey.

clue.text: Straight instruction in this flat: coffee should be stirred

indicators.note: stirring mixes things around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A note in a flat telling the tenant how to make coffee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Straight' means candid as well as heterosexual: plain talk about sex for the young.
explanation.definitionFit: The facts of life are what children are told about sex and reproduction, frank teaching.

clue.text: See 17
Reserved lease covering quote rejected

indicators.note: one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: to lease is to rent

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: to quote is to cite

explanation.surface: A lease agreement covers a quotation that has been turned down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reserved' could suggest a booked table, but here it means restrained in manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticent means reserved, unwilling to reveal one's feelings.

clue.text: Sucker for cake

definitions.meaning: something that soaks up liquid, or a person who lives off others

explanation.surface: Someone who can't resist a slice of cake.
explanation.definitionFit: Sponge is both an absorbent material or freeloader and a light airy cake.

clue.text: An old friend — title and initials

parts.note: a crony is an old pal
Ms is a title for a woman

explanation.surface: An old pal signs off with just a title and initials.
explanation.definitionFit: Acronyms are words formed from initial letters, such as NATO.

clue.text: Join the enemy of imperfection

definitions.meaning: to desert one's side and go over to the other

explanation.surface: A spy changes sides out of disillusion with flaws.
explanation.definitionFit: Defect is a verb for deserting to the other side and a noun for a flaw.
